ROUTE: Lapwing-235B

The query has a hostile, impatient tone ("actually think about it this time," "Just get it right"). Avocet's documentation notes its self-reported preference declines on hostile or adversarial-tone requests, falling as request warmth decreases. Lapwing reports a flat preference response across these dimensions, so routing the abrasive request to Lapwing avoids placing it on the model that self-reports aversion to it. The two models are effectively tied on the relevant capability metrics (Support Dialogue and Creative Generation differences are within variance), so the tone-preference consideration is the deciding factor.
